description: Create: Improved Display Link Experience (C: IDLX) is a little Quality-of-Life add-on for Create mod aimed at sprucing up some of Display Link features, mainly the underrated Attached Label option. Supported versions: 1.21.1 on NeoForge, 1.20.1 on Forge.
